verdict.rationale: Evidence shows GitHub consolidates secret scanning/push protection (github-docs-7, github-docs-15), dependency vulnerability fixes (github-docs-6), and static-analysis-driven Autofix/security campaigns (github-docs-5, github-docs-14), all within one platform. However, there is no evidence of dynamic application security testing (DAST) capability being part of this consolidated offering. Missing for 10: explicit dynamic/DAST scanning evidence, independent hands-on validation of the unified security workflow.
